name: Pension Hieber
beschreibung:
The Pension Hieber is listed in the accommodation overview for Telfs in the Innsbruck region. The entry describes a quietly situated house with cosy rooms furnished in the traditional Tyrolean wood style and a breakfast buffet with regional products. According to the description, the surroundings are suitable for hiking and skiing.

Telfs is a market town in the Inn Valley, about half an hour west of Innsbruck, at an altitude of around 634 metres, at the foot of the Hohe Munde. The municipality in the district of Innsbruck-Land is well connected via the Inntal motorway and the S-Bahn; Innsbruck, the Seefeld Plateau and the surrounding hiking and skiing areas are quickly reachable.
